current_semantics.consequence: transient reservations become permanent exclusions for the lifetime of DynamicReservationLeaseSession

sequence: A becomes reserved before provider work, so A is added permanently and session moves to B
B is added permanently; historical avoid set is now A+B
selection fails although A is currently free

coverage_gap: Current test_dynamic_reservation_lease_session.py covers late reservation and recovery/reselection, but not release of a previously reserved account followed by reservation of the replacement slot.
safe_contract: Do not conflate persistent exclusions with the current reservation snapshot.
A transiently reserved account may become eligible again after release.
If that account already participated in provider work, re-entry must preserve the existing fresh/full-history recovery rule and must never reuse stale cross-account thread affinity implicitly.
Keep a bounded anti-livelock budget, but do not exhaust the pool solely because every slot was transiently reserved at different times.
